_comment: MaowCore Discord music bot + dashboard. Import in the admin area: Nests > Import Egg.
name: MaowCore
author: lara@maowcore.local
description: MaowCore: a Discord music + community bot (YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, leveling, modmail, giveaways, automod) with a web dashboard. The dashboard runs on this server's port; open http://<server address>:<port>/ once it says "Logged in as".
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then echo "Updating from GitHub..."; git fetch --quiet origin {{BRANCH}} && git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund; fi; if [[ -f deploy/pterodactyl/start.sh ]]; then exec bash deploy/pterodactyl/start.sh; else node index.js; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# MaowCore install script for Pterodactyl (egg-maowcore.json embeds this file).
# Runs once in a node:22-trixie container; the server's files live in /mnt/server.
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git curl ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# 1. Get the code: clone the repo, pull if it's already a checkout,
#    or leave uploaded files alone.
if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
  [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]] && GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}.git"
  if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    # private repo: put the login into the URL
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo "${GIT_ADDRESS}" | cut -d/ -f3-)"
  fi
  if [ -d .git ]; then
    echo "Existing checkout found, pulling the latest code"
    git pull
  elif [ -z "$(ls -A)" ]; then
    echo "Cloning ${BRANCH:-main}"
    git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH:-main}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
  else
    echo "The server folder has files but no git checkout, so nothing was cloned."
    echo "Either upload the bot's files yourself, or empty the folder and reinstall."
  fi
fi

# 2. Standalone yt-dlp (no Python needed). The bot finds it in ./bin by itself.
mkdir -p bin data cookies
case "$(uname -m)" in
  aarch64|arm64) YTDLP=yt-dlp_linux_aarch64 ;;
  *)             YTDLP=yt-dlp_linux ;;
esac
curl -fsSL "https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/${YTDLP}" -o bin/yt-dlp
chmod +x bin/yt-dlp
./bin/yt-dlp --version

# 3. Node packages, built for Linux (never copy node_modules from Windows).
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  rm -rf node_modules
  npm install --omit=dev
else
  echo "No package.json yet; upload the bot and restart the server."
fi

echo "MaowCore install finished."

variables.name: Discord bot token
variables.description: Developer Portal > your app > Bot > Reset Token.

variables.name: Application ID
variables.description: Developer Portal > your app > General Information > Application ID.

variables.name: Test server ID
variables.description: Optional. Slash commands appear in this server instantly; leave blank for all servers (up to an hour).

variables.name: Extra owner user IDs
variables.description: Optional. The bot's two owners are built in; add more permanent owners here as Discord user IDs separated by commas (Settings > Advanced > Developer Mode, then right-click a name > Copy User ID). Owners are always owner on the dashboard and pass the bot's permission checks in every server.

variables.name: Dashboard token
variables.description: Password for the web dashboard. Leave blank and the bot makes one on first start, saved in data/control-token.txt.

variables.name: Discord sign-in secret
variables.description: Optional: lets people sign in to the dashboard with Discord. Developer Portal > your app > OAuth2 > Client Secret. Also set the dashboard public URL below.

variables.name: Require sign-in
variables.description: 1 = the dashboard needs a Discord sign-in (or the token) for everything; 0 = the dashboard token alone.

variables.name: Command prefix
variables.description: Optional. Puts a prefix in front of every slash command name (e.g. "mc" makes /play into /mc-play), for running two bots in one server. Lowercase letters, digits and _ only.

variables.name: Backup DMs
variables.description: How often the bot DMs its owner (Owner user ID above) a backup of its data: weekly, daily or off. No songs, cookies or logins are included.

variables.name: Dashboard public URL
variables.description: Optional. The address people use to reach the dashboard, e.g. http://node.example.com:25570 (needed for Discord sign-in).

variables.name: Git repo
variables.description: Where the install script gets the code. Leave blank to upload the files yourself.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: Only for a private repo: a GitHub token with read access to it.

variables.name: Update on start
variables.description: 1 = get the newest code from GitHub (and its packages) every time the server starts. Files you edited on the server that are part of the code get replaced; data/, cookies/ and .env are kept.
